crossRefs.note: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”
brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

translations.web: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
translations.bsb: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
translations.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
translations.asv: In the mean while the disciples prayed him, saying, Rabbi, eat.
